rows.notes: The cited document is explicitly labelled a Review Article (Mathematical Problems in Engineering, 2019). It contains no original data, experiment, survey or model runs; it describes remote sensing indices, satellite platforms (Table 1), vegetation indices (Table 2) and generic machine-learning classification methods, citing other work throughout. Q1 is therefore 'no' and all other questions follow as 'no'. The claim about remote sensing enabling maximized crop yield, resource administration and sustainability is a conceptual assertion that this review does not test.
